nihari: Pakistani beef nihari: a dark ceramic bowl of glossy reddish-brown beef stew with a layer of orange oil on top, tender beef chunks, garnished with thin ginger juliennes, sliced green chillies and fresh coriander leaves
chicken_biryani: Pakistani chicken biryani: a round plate piled high with long-grain basmati rice in white, yellow and orange strands, a chicken leg piece, a potato half, fried brown onions, mint leaves and a lemon wedge
kadhi_pakora: Pakistani kadhi pakora: a bowl of thick bright yellow yogurt and gram-flour curry with round golden-brown fried pakora fritters soaking in it, topped with a tempering of red dried chillies and curry leaves
pizza_malai_boti: a single triangular pizza slice topped with creamy white malai chicken chunks, melted mozzarella, green capsicum pieces and red onion, golden crust
roti: a round whole-wheat chapati flatbread, thin and light brown with darker toasted spots, slightly folded on a small plate
samosa_aloo: a single golden-brown crispy triangular Pakistani samosa with flaky pastry, one corner broken open showing spiced yellow potato and peas filling, small bowl of green chutney beside it
gulab_jamun: two round dark brown glossy gulab jamun sweets soaking in golden sugar syrup in a small white bowl, sprinkled with chopped pistachio
doodh_patti: a glass cup of creamy light-brown Pakistani doodh patti milk tea with a little froth on top, on a saucer
banana: a single ripe yellow banana with a few brown speckles
seekh_kebab: two long cylindrical brown grilled beef seekh kebabs on a metal skewer with charred grill marks, with onion rings and a lemon wedge
zinger: a tall zinger burger: sesame bun with a thick crunchy golden fried chicken fillet, lettuce and white mayonnaise
chapli_kebab: a large round flat Peshawari chapli kebab, dark brown and crispy at the edges, studded with red tomato slice on top and pomegranate seeds, with onion rings
